description:
Find events along a driving route in Japan, with car navigation URLs.
ドライブルート沿いのイベントを検索し、Google Mapsカーナビ付きで返す。

出発地→目的地のルート沿いを等間隔でスキャンし、周辺イベントを収集する。
結果にはイベント一覧と、選んだイベントを経由地に含むカーナビURLが含まれる。

category.description: Event category key(s), comma separated. See list_categories (e.g. festival, culture, sports)

date_from.description: Events held on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today (ended events are excluded)

date_to.description: Events starting on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

include_experiences.description: Also include year-round bookable experiences/activities (tours, workshops), listed after dated events

keyword.description: Keyword matched against title/description/translations (Japanese or English, e.g. "花火", "fireworks")

lang.description: Language of the user's conversation: ja, en, zh or ko (default ja). Sets joino_url to the page in that language

radius_km.description: Search radius from the route in km (default 15)

name: search_route_events
title: Search events along a route
